# Probes by the controller (09/10/2026, about 23:30 to 23:50)

Run on a clone of `~/metis-run/verify` (cp -c, copy-on-write) in the temporary folder of the session, without
touching the repo. Before cloning: the source code `src/` of that copy matched the repo byte for byte (shasum of the whole tree:
`0721dacdfcd65da605af357a976ba24c2a172669` in both). Each probe edits one line, runs, then restores the original
file and checks with `cmp` (both scripts print `restored OK`).

## Reading the wrong data field on screen 24 (`probe-fieldswap.sh`)

Run every Jest test of `src/screens` and `src/shell` (84 suites, 704 tests, on every Jest project).

| Probe | Line edited | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline, no edit | none | 84 suites passed, 704 tests passed |
| The Delayed tile turns red by the amount of change | `model.ts:74` `alert: delayed.value > 0` changed to `alert: change > 0` | 704 passed: defect slipped through |
| The Delayed tile shows the amount of change | `model.ts:74` `value: num(c, delayed.value)` changed to `value: num(c, change)` | 704 passed: defect slipped through |
| The risk card counts by the high-risk metric | `model.lists.ts:96` `count: num(c, risks.total)` changed to `num(c, data.metrics.highRisk.value)` | 704 passed: defect slipped through |

The cause can be read in the mock data: `meridian.ts:31-32` has `value: 2` and `sinceBaseline: 2`;
`meridian.ts:35` has `highRisk.value: 4` and `meridian.ts:89` has `risks.total: 4`. When two numbers are always equal,
reading the wrong field gives the same text either way.

## ESLint rules and the trace gate (`probe-lint-trace.sh`)

Each negative probe (expecting the defect to slip through) has a positive control (must be caught), so that "no error reported" means something.

| File planted in the clone | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `src/core/zzcanary-expo.ts`: `import { router } from 'expo-router'` | slips through (the rule bans only the names `react`, `react-native`) | exit 0: slipped through |
| `src/core/zzcanary-rn.ts`: `import { View } from 'react-native'` (control) | caught | exit 1, `no-restricted-imports` |
| `src/screens/24-project-overview/model.zzcanary1.ts`: `import { HealthCard } from './blocks/HealthCard'` | slips through (a model may import anything in the folder of its screen) | exit 0: slipped through |
| `model.zzcanary2.ts`: `import { Tile } from '../../design-system/Tile'` (control) | caught | exit 1, `import/no-restricted-paths`, Vietnamese message "model.ts is plain TypeScript (spec 3.2)" |
| `model.zzcanary3.ts`: `import { View } from 'react-native'` (control: the rule of the model applies to this file name) | caught | exit 1, `no-restricted-imports` |
| `src/shell/ZzCanary.tsx`: `<Text>No items</Text>` | slips through (the rule on text in JSX applies only to the design system) | exit 0: slipped through |
| `src/design-system/ZzCanary.tsx`: same content (control) | caught | exit 1, `no-restricted-syntax`, Vietnamese message "The text of a design system component goes through a required prop, never written directly (spec 5.5)" |

The trace gate (`scripts/check-trace.mjs`). The id BR-24 has only one test that carries its name
(`Screen.test.native.tsx:172`; `e2e/web/contract.spec.ts:15` is only an array element, not a name).

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| Baseline | exit 0 |
| Change that test to `test.skip(` | exit 0, prints "check-trace: 9 requirement ids, every id has a test that carries its name": the gate passes even though no test of BR-24 runs |
| Control: change BR-24 in the name to BR-2X | exit 1, prints "requirement ids with no test that carries their name: 24-project-overview: BR-24" |
